company_overview: Postman is a unified API platform for designing, testing, distributing, documenting, and monitoring APIs. It simplifies each step of the API lifecycle and streamlines collaboration to help teams create better APIs faster.
target_audience: Developers and enterprise engineering teams building, testing, and managing APIs.
leadership: Abhinav Asthana (CEO and co-founder); Ankit Sobti (Co-founder); Abhijit Kane (Co-founder)

company_overview: Supabase is an open-source Firebase alternative built on top of a PostgreSQL database. It provides developers with tools for authentication, instant APIs, edge functions, real-time data sync, and storage.
target_audience: Developers and startups building scalable web and mobile applications.

company_overview: Vapi provides a unified platform for developers and enterprises to build, test, and deploy voice AI agents. The platform handles the underlying infrastructure, orchestration, and real-time monitoring to enable scalable voice experiences with low latency.
target_audience: Developers and enterprises looking to build, scale, and deploy reliable voice AI agents for customer support and automation.
